harper: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: I distilled three parallel tracks to avoid repeat OOMs — deterministic repro, short-term guardrails, and slab/GC experiments. Drop ownership or :thumbsup:.
noah: I'll own the deterministic repro and trace collection. plan: 6h staged run with alloc-sample=1% and skew sweep.
claire: I'll take slab/GC experiments on canary and a conservative rollout plan.
sre-bot: reminder: please attach runbook link when creating alerts: infra/runbooks/kv-residency.md
harper: repro details (noah):
```bash
TRACE_DIR=/tmp/kvtraces
./kv_repro --pool=staging --clients=130 --skew-start=0.6 --skew-end=0.95 --step=0.05 --duration=21600 --alloc-sample=1% --out=$TRACE_DIR/trace-$(date +%s).tgz
```
noah: upload target: s3://redwood-inference-dev/kv-traces/pm-2432104567/ and tag files with thread-2432104567. I'll also include a short gist with harness steps. ETA 18h.
claire: slab/GC experiment plan:
- canary A: frag_threshold 0.34 -> 0.5 (48h)
- canary B: compact-window 60s -> 25s for hotspot shards (72h)
- canary C: enable eager-evict for segments > 88MB (72h)
Rollback criteria: any OOM or p99 read latency > 1.6x baseline. I'll add dashboards and a quick revert playbook.
harper: short-term guardrails (ops): per-tenant soft limit and growth throttles. Suggest default soft-multiplier=0.9 for tenants in >95th percentile and an emergency global cap at 0.85 if sustained cluster-level residency > 0.8 for 15m. Thoughts?
ops: ops ok to implement default soft-multiplier 0.9 (opt-out for enterprise). global emergency cap needs SRE review; can prototype as a kill-switch flag. ETA for rules & basic tickets: 6h.
noah: repro observations so far: leak correlates with sustained alloc_delta > 30MB/s for >10m on shards with frag >0.4. Will add that pattern to the alert proposal.
claire: important note: eager-evict trades off eviction churn for lower residency. Will instrument eviction-failures and eviction-latency. Add panels for eviction_rate, eviction_fail_pct, residency, frag, and alloc_delta/s.
sre-bot: deploy checklist: ensure canary has extra monitoring retention and rollback playbook attached.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary slab-config rollout -> pool-canary-7 -> ETA 2026-05-02T03:30:00Z
harper: ownership summary (confirm):
- deterministic repro & traces: noah (ETA 18h)
- slab/GC experiments & canary rollout: claire (ETA start 2026-05-02)
- tenant soft-multiplier & alert tickets: ops (ETA 6h)
- retro writeup + metrics: harper (ETA 2026-05-07)
noah: confirmed. will upload first traces and link here.
claire: prepping canary PR; will include flags to make eager-evict opt-in per-pool.
ops: creating tickets and runbook link; will add opt-out flow for enterprise tenants.
harper: one operational question — do we want a temporary global soft-limit per-tenant while canary runs? pros: reduces blast radius; cons: might degrade some customers. If ops can make it opt-out, I'm inclined to run for 48h.
ops: we can implement as feature-flagged and opt-out per-tenant. We'll default to on for 48h for safety.
noah: snippet from a suspicious staging run:
"[2026-05-01T14:22:09Z] shard=23 residency=0.81 alloc_delta=+42MB/s frag=0.43 gc_runs=1 eviction_rate=12/s"
harper: OK — reconvene in 48h with metrics snapshots and the repro archive. If any canary OOMs appear, page #eng-oncall and tag this thread. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
